groups.name: server.netty
groups.description: Configuration properties for the Netty-based web server that replaces Tomcat in this starter.

properties.name: server.netty.boss-threads
properties.description: Size of the event-loop group that accepts connections; 0 applies Netty's default. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.worker-threads
properties.description: Size of the event-loop group that reads and writes on accepted connections; 0 applies Netty's default. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.tcp-keep-alive
properties.description: Socket-level SO_KEEPALIVE on accepted connections. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.shutdown-grace-period
properties.description: How long graceful shutdown drains before force-closing. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.read-timeout
properties.description: The slow-loris deadline, measured on the client rather than on your handler. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.write-stall-timeout
properties.description: How long a response waits on a client that has stopped reading it; 0 or negative disables it. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.max-chunk-size
properties.description: Upper bound on the pieces a request body is delivered in. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.transport
properties.description: Netty I/O transport: auto, nio, epoll or kqueue. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

values.description: Not a default; the backlog it yields depends on the transport.
Any negative value also disables the read timeout.
